title: UI refresh with colorful gradient theme + mobile wrapper branding assets (Android/iOS)

requirements.text: Refresh the existing app UI styling (colors, fonts, and button styling) to a colorful gradient look while keeping all current screen layouts and routes unchanged.

quotes: just refreshed colors/fonts/buttons while keeping the current layout

acceptanceCriteria: All existing routes continue to render with the same structure and navigation behavior (no layout reworks, no route changes).
Global theme tokens (CSS variables) are updated to reflect a colorful gradient-forward palette while maintaining readability/contrast in both light and dark mode.
Buttons (including primary and outline variants) visually reflect the new style (e.g., gradient primary, improved hover/active/focus states) without breaking Shadcn component usage.
All user-facing text introduced or changed remains in English.

requirements.text: Apply the refreshed gradient styling consistently across shared layout elements, including the header area in MobileScaffold and the BottomNav active-state styling, without changing their layout structure.

quotes: Yes change the ui and make it attractive and creative

acceptanceCriteria: The MobileScaffold header remains the same size/structure but visually aligns with the new gradient theme.
Bottom navigation active tab styling is updated to match the new primary/gradient style while keeping tab labels and icons unchanged.
No principals or identifying metadata are introduced into the UI as part of styling changes.

requirements.text: Create simple default mobile branding assets for a web-view wrapper app: an app icon and splash screen designs suitable for Android and iOS.
acceptanceCriteria: New image assets are generated according to the filenames/dimensions listed in imageRequirements.required.
Assets are purely visual (no sensitive/identifying content) and match a colorful gradient style that fits the app’s existing inclusive theme.

requirements.text: Add the newly generated mobile branding images to the frontend as static assets under frontend/public/assets/generated and document (in-repo) how they should be used for Android (APK) and iOS (IPA) web-view wrapper packaging.

quotes: Yes I want android apk and for i phone also

acceptanceCriteria: The generated images are present under frontend/public/assets/generated and can be referenced by static path at runtime.

A short, English README (or equivalent doc file) is added to the repo describing how to apply the icon and splash assets when creating Android/iOS web-view wrapper builds (including which filenames to use).
No backend changes are required for the branding asset work.

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (compose existing UI components instead).
Do not edit any frontend immutable paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT (e.g., frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts(x), frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx).
Keep the current layout and navigation structure; only refresh styling (colors/fonts/buttons).
Keep all user-facing text in English.
nonGoals: Implementing new app features beyond UI styling refresh and branding assets.
Publishing to Google Play Store or Apple App Store.
Adding third-party authentication (only Internet Identity is supported).
Changing backend data models or running state migrations solely for styling/branding changes.

required: Mobile app icon, colorful gradient with a clean abstract mark (app-icon.dim_1024x1024.png)
Mobile splash screen, colorful gradient background with subtle abstract shapes (splash-screen.dim_2732x2732.png)
